# Lifecycle

The canonical loop is task discovery, contract, route, preflight, execution, verification, review, validator-backed completion, and a terminal next check. Always query `next` rather than inferring a transition. The initial post-task-create shape may have no work state: `next` returns DISCOVER, then CREATE_CONTRACT, and only a real contract fingerprint permits the first work-state checkpoint.

Phases are runtime-owned and currently include: RECEIVED, DISCOVERING, CONTRACT_READY, ROUTED, DESIGNING, PLANNED, EXECUTING, VERIFYING, DIAGNOSING, CORRECTING, REVIEWING, COMPLETE, BLOCKED.
